name: Mailchimp

evidence.marketing: F02: lifecycle marketing flows alongside campaigns

line: Email campaigns and marketing automation with a transactional add-on.

cells.api: Yes, Transactional needs paid Standard or higher

subs.math: 1,000 contacts and 4,000 sends fit inside the 10,000-send allowance. The base fee for the selected contact band is not settled.
5,000 contacts and 20,000 sends fit inside the 50,000-send allowance. The base fee for the selected contact band is not settled.
10,000 contacts and 40,000 sends fit inside the 100,000-send allowance. The base fee for the selected contact band is not settled.
50,000 contacts and 200,000 emails fit inside the 500,000-send allowance.

appmail.math: USD 20 Standard plan, plus 1 block at USD 20, gives 25,000 monthly app emails, covering 3,000.
USD 20 Standard plan, plus 1 block at USD 20, gives 25,000 monthly app emails, covering 10,000.
USD 20 Standard plan, plus 2 blocks at USD 20 each, gives 50,000 monthly app emails.
USD 20 Standard plan, plus 4 blocks at USD 20 each, gives 100,000 monthly app emails.
